title: Gibraltar Overview
text: Great experience as a overview of Gibraltar and saw all the touristic features, just not enough time to see them in more detail
author: Richard_R

title: Rafael was awesome!
text: Rafael was a fantastic tour guide. He paid great attention to detail and was very informative. I would highly recommend taking a tour with him.
author: tammiclementi

title: Gibraltar Day Trip
text: Prepare for hot weather even if you are traveling in late October. Just the right amount of time to spend in Gibraltar.
author: MaryAnn_W

title: Gibraltar is a must see!
text: From Seville, it was a 2 hour drive and then about a 30 minute walk to the tour bus. This place is bustling.  Our tour bus driver was David, born and raised in Gibraltar.  We had 4 stops with included a visit to see monkeys. They were very friendly 😀. We had fish n chips for lunch. Gibraltar is actually a British colony. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there. Our driver from Seville was Rafael,  who was very knowledgeable and friendly.
author: Deanna_G

title: Great trip to Gibtraltar
text: Our driver picked up at our hotel and drove us to Gibraltar. He pointed out interesting sites along the way and picked us up at the end of the day. All great!
author: eileen_d

title: Spectacular views, monkeys, caves, and history
text: When traveling solo, be aware that someone else also must sign up for the trip. The company was not inclined to drive from Seville to Gibraltar with only one passenger (understandably). Fortunately, someone else joined at the last minute. The visit itself was spectacular: Monkeys, caves, hundreds of years of history. Africa quite visible across the straits. Also, notable contrast between Spanish culture on one side of the demarcation line and British culture on the other. Definitely worth the trip. author: Mason_S

title: Visiting the Rock
text: Jose drove us to the Rock from Sevilla and was so helpful, pleasant and personable. He made the drive there seem shorter than it was. Our driver from Brands was very knowledgeable, and shared a lot of great information. He took great care to ensure that we enjoyed meeting his friends, “the monkeys”. The views are absolutely stunning and the scope of the military operation inside the Rock was very interesting. There is so much history attached to this little spot in the world.
author: Barbara_V

title: Ride up the Rock
text: Fidelio was a guide extraordinaire! He knew all the history of Gibraltar, answered all our questions, and brought the monkeys close to us for photos. And the cave experience was a treat.
author: Beverly_W

title: The perfect day trip!
text: Gibraltar was a great day trip from Seville. Our Spanish guide was very helpful and knowledgeable, answered all our questions and provided us with all the information on how to get the best out of Gibraltar and detailed information about crossing the border. We had a great time and the views were amazing.
author: Salvador_D

title: This trip was amazing! So...
text: This trip was amazing! So well planned, perfect time spent everywhere! The transport was an 8 passenger van which was very clean and allowed me to make great friends with the other people on the trip! The monkeys were SO FUN!
author: Abigail_M
